raw_text: Read REQUIREMENTS.md then DESIGN.md; prioritize REQUIREMENTS.md > DESIGN.md. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. Ask user if not documented. Do not implement based on independent judgment. MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits. MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing. MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing. If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing. Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues. Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files.
